annotations.title: Transcribe an attached audio or video file

description: Transcribe an audio or video file the user attached to this conversation, using speech-to-text (mp3, m4a, wav, mp4, webm and similar). Use it for an attached media file; YouTube links use transcriptlab_get_transcript instead. Spends credits per audio minute. Attachments up to 300 MB work here; larger files (up to 2 GB) use the launcher upload view. Stores the file, starts transcription, and returns an upload_id: poll transcriptlab_get_speech_transcript with it, waiting a few seconds between tries and stopping after about ten. Do not call this again for the same file. If it fails or the file is too large, call transcriptlab_open with tab "upload".

diarize.description: Label speakers; defaults to false. Implies tier=premium.

lang.description: Optional ISO 639-1 spoken language hint (e.g. "ar", "en", "es"); omit or "auto" to auto-detect.

tier.description: Speech model tier; defaults to auto (normal when available).
